_comment: LandfallElementals 2026-10-18 (lfe-land cluster): the landfall SELF PUMP (landfall_self_pump_power/
_toughness) seen by the search through BOTH land-entry routes. Mountain + Forest untapped, an OLD
Akoum Hellhound (0/1) and an uncracked Terramorphic Expanse; hand Brushfire Elemental (1/1 haste) +
Mountain; opponent at 9; resumed at main 1 of T4. Exact lethal T4 ONLY by: CAST BRUSHFIRE FIRST
(Mountain + Forest), THEN play the Mountain (landfall 1: Hellhound 2/3, Brushfire 3/3), and crack the
Expanse for a basic (landfall 2: 4/5 and 5/5) -> 4 + 5 = 9. Land-first makes Brushfire miss the drop's
pump: 4 + 3 = 7, no win. So the T4 win needs (a) the pump in the rollout as well as the executor,
(b) the searched land-drop position after a landfall-watcher cast (Plan::land_slot), (c) the crack in
the trailing pass AFTER the cast, and (d) Brushfire's haste. Filler = Forest: the crack's target; no
draw happens before the win (resume_at main1).
